name: Shlyakh kokhannya: Perepleteni doli.
source:
The protagonist, Sabrina, lived a quiet and peaceful life. Everything was fine, life was going on as usual until the young lady met a new celebrity named Isaiah, who'd transferred to her university as an exchange student. The arrogant and proud man begins to pester our heroine in every possible way and turn her into an errand girl. Young Sabrina is facing hard times, and she has to decide whether to show her true self or fall for his tricks.

[Translated/Edited from [url=https://nana-nanachi.itch.io/shlyakh-kokhannya]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
主人公萨布丽娜过着平静祥和的生活。一切都很好，生活一如往常，直到这位年轻的女士遇到了一位名叫以赛亚的新名人，他作为交换生转学到她的大学。这个傲慢自大的男人开始百般纠缠我们的女主角，把她变成了一个跑腿的女孩。年轻的萨布丽娜面临着艰难的时刻，她必须决定是展现真实的自我还是落入他的诡计之中。

[翻译/编辑自 [url=https://nana-nanachi.itch.io/shlyakh-kokhannya]itch.io[/url]]
